items.title: Lube the chain
items.description: More often in wet or dusty conditions. A dry chain wears the whole drivetrain.

items.title: Check chain wear
items.description: Replace at 0.5% stretch before it takes the cassette and chainrings with it.

items.title: Check brake pads & cables
items.description: Pad thickness, cable fray, hydraulic feel.

items.title: Full tune-up
items.description: Bearings, derailleur adjustment, wheel true, bolt torque.

items.title: Refresh tubeless sealant
items.description: Tubeless tires only. Sealant dries out whether or not you ride.

items.title: Suspension service
items.description: Fork and shock, per the manufacturer's hour interval.
